title: Factorial helper
prompt: Write a function named factorial that takes a whole number n that is zero or larger and returns n factorial, the product of every whole number from 1 up to n. The factorial of 0 is 1. This is a helper of the kind you would keep in your own utility module, so write it yourself without importing anything. Return the number, do not print it.

title: Greatest common divisor
prompt: Write a function named gcd that takes two whole numbers a and b, both 1 or larger, and returns the largest whole number that divides them both exactly. For example gcd(12, 18) is 6. This is a helper of the kind you would keep in your own utility module, so write it yourself without importing anything. Return the number, do not print it.

title: Median helper
prompt: Write a function named median that takes a list of numbers and returns the middle value once they are in order. When the list has an even number of items, return the average of the two middle values. When the list is empty, return 0. Sort a copy so the caller's list is left alone. This is a helper of the kind you would keep in your own utility module, so write it yourself without importing anything. Return the number, do not print it.

title: Sum of the digits
prompt: Write a function named sum_of_digits that takes a whole number n that is zero or larger and returns the sum of its digits, so 123 gives 6. Work it out with arithmetic using the remainder and floor division operators. This is a helper of the kind you would keep in your own utility module, so write it yourself without importing anything. Return the number, do not print it.

title: Prime check
prompt: Write a function named is_prime that takes a whole number n and returns True when it is a prime number and False when it is not. A prime number is 2 or larger and is divisible only by 1 and itself, so 1, 0 and every negative number are not prime. This is a helper of the kind you would keep in your own utility module, so write it yourself without importing anything. Return the True or False value, do not print it.
